Created the Rust project in `/output` with the required root entry file [test11.rs](/output/test11.rs) and modular library code under [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs). The implementation uses only `std`, reimplements the immutable vector behavior with a small `PersistentVector`, and includes a `stoi`-style parser so CLI handling matches the C++ binary’s permissive parsing behavior.

Builds succeeded with both `cargo build --release` in `/output` and `rustc --edition=2021 /output/test11.rs -o /output/test11`. The runnable binaries are `/output/test11` and `/output/target/release/test11`. I verified matching behavior against `/workspace/dataset/test11_executable` for default invocation, `0`, `4`, `12abc`, `-3`, `65536`, plus invalid and out-of-range inputs including matching stderr text and exit status `134` on parse failures.
